title: Mămăligă cu Brânză
description: A classic dish from Moldova, featuring corn grits, bryndza, sour cream. A practical home-kitchen version with measured step ingredients and clear cooking methods.

steps.instruction: Combine these ingredients in a pot, bring just to a boil and skim any foam. Simmer gently for about 5 minutes to make a flavorful base.
Slowly stir the grains into the simmering liquid; cook over low heat for about 25 minutes, stirring to prevent sticking.
Stir in these seasonings and additions. Taste, adjust the balance and let the dish stand briefly before serving.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
